character.quality: Realistic textured realtime human; lower detail than a modern scan.

explorationHandoff.validation: Source architectural and furniture colliders: 60 fixed steps under 0.1 mm drift; five follow-camera clearance rays clear over 2.469 m.

buildNotes.sourceGeometry: Evaluated from the supplied original Blender file; original file unchanged.
buildNotes.lighting: Static Cycles indirect and practical diffuse illumination, live sun shadows, source-room reflection captures.
knownLimits: Reflections omit moving character and changes to screen content.

limitations: All camera splines require visual review after geometric collision checks.
